Businesses are already
looking for AI help.
Become the person they call.

3500+ AI CREDENTIALS AWARDED BY AI INNOVISION · CPD-ACCREDITED · #23, INC. 50 FASTEST-GROWING WOMEN-OWNED/LED COMPANIES 2026

The only AI consultant certification that gives you the training, the software, and the real-world blueprint to build a career long after the hype fades.

FULL LIFETIME ACCESS
LIVE TRAINING
PRIVATE COMMUNITY
ENROLL NOW
WHAT'S INSIDE

Immediate access upon enrollment.

“Several departments within McDonald’s Corporation ordered my book, AI Simplified, and asked me to come on site to train their franchise owners. That was an amazing accomplishment for me and my business.”
— Jzquelyn Burnom
Certified AI Consultant · IT Professional · Author, AI Simplified · Northwest Indiana
THE OPPORTUNITY
Organizations have AI. They need guidance.

Businesses have access to powerful AI tools. What many are missing is a person who can help them use those tools well.

THEY NEED SOMEONE WHO CAN HELP THEM:
1.
Understand
where AI fits
2.
Identify
high-value opportunities
3.
Implement
practical AI workflows
4.
Train
their people
5.
Build
an AI strategy
THE DEMAND SIGNAL
AI is transforming business. Most organizations need help getting there.
86%
Of employers expect AI to transform their business by 2030
World Economic Forum, Future of Jobs Report 2025
94%
Of businesses are at least somewhat likely to invest in AI-specific training in 2026
CompTIA IT Industry Outlook 2026
$1.8T
Projected global AI market by 2030
Grand View Research
THE ROLE
What exactly does an AI consultant do?

AI consultants help organizations understand where AI can create value — and turn that understanding into practical action.

THE CENTER
AI
Consultant

Hover a path to explore

1:1 CONSULTING
STAGE SPEAKING
CORPORATE TRAINING
SUMMITS
AI AUDITS
AI STRATEGY
COURSES
WEBINARS
WORKSHOPS

One consulting skill set. Many ways to create value.

WHO THIS IS FOR
You don’t have to start as an AI expert.

Your industry experience, business knowledge, communication skills, and network can all become part of how you approach AI consulting.

AI is the new capability. Your existing expertise is part of the foundation.

Venecia P. Cuffe
Founder, Vens Business Solutions · Nursing background
“

I have a nursing background, and I stepped away from nursing to care for my own mother. My bucket list: becoming a motivational speaker and returning to work with the wisdom population — our mature generation, who deserve someone with time to truly listen. When I saw what AI could do, I saw a way to fast-track every one of those goals at once. There was no hesitation.

This program has put me at tables I never imagined sitting at — side by side with the Governor of Rhode Island, and on a government commission panel on AI and the community of color. Little Venecia from Jamaica, who just wanted to care for people, at the governor’s table. And it doesn’t stop there: a nonprofit leader found me through a community event, I built the presentation she could never have made on her own — and that was a paid project.

WHERE OUR CONSULTANTS COME FROM

ROLES
Consultants
Coaches
Trainers
Speakers
Business Professionals
Entrepreneurs
Educators
Nonprofit leaders
INDUSTRIES

Healthcare, coaching, small business, education — the community is built on people from every field, not one background.

INSIDE THE CERTIFICATION
Everything you’re getting.

First, the skills behind the consulting. Then the CPD certification you earn. Plus the welcome kit that arrives at your door and the custom software you’ll work with as a consultant.

THE ONLINE TRAINING PORTAL
Build the skills behind the consulting.

Here’s what the program covers — learning areas that take you from understanding AI to advising real organizations with confidence.

01
AI Consulting Foundations

What an AI consultant actually does — and how the role fits into real organizations.

02
Client Discovery

How to uncover what a client truly needs, beyond the surface-level request.

03
AI Tools & Prompting

Getting hands-on with the tools of the trade and using them with confidence.

04
AI Strategy

Connecting AI capabilities to business goals so your recommendations have a purpose.

05
AI Audits & Use Cases

Assessing where AI can help — and where it can’t — inside a real business.

06
Proposals & Consulting Services

Turning your findings into clear, professional proposals clients can say yes to.

07
AI Training & Education

Teaching and upskilling others, from workshops to structured programs.

08
Consulting Business Development

Finding opportunities and building a practice around your new expertise.

YOUR CERTIFICATION
Then, earn your certification.

Complete the program and pass the assessments to earn your CPD certification as a certified AI consultant — with 20 hours of CPD credit.

Certified consultants are listed in the IAAC Directory.

A SAMPLE OF THE CERTIFICATE YOU’LL EARN

01
Complete the program

Move through the training at your own pace, building your AI consulting skills along the way.

02
Pass the assessments

Show what you’ve learned through the program’s assessments.

03
Earn your CPD certification

Receive your CPD-accredited certificate and officially become a certified AI consultant.

YOUR WELCOME KIT
And it doesn’t stop on screen.

When you enroll, your physical welcome kit ships straight to your door, anywhere in the world: the certification box, the AI Consultant’s Playbook, the AI Consultant’s Notebook, your “I Am an AI Consultant” t-shirt, and a welcome postcard to mark the start.

PRACTICAL TOOLS
We knew what consultants needed. So we built the software for it.

The program includes practical, custom-built software that handles the heavy lifting so you can focus on advising the client — finding speaking gigs, pricing proposals, and delivering client-ready AI audits.

Lifetime tool access: every tool stays available to you for the life of the program, with updates included.

TOOL 01
Find AI Speaking Gigs

A searchable database of real speaking opportunities — conferences, podcasts, webinars, and summits — filtered to your industry, niche, and the formats you want.

No more hours scrolling LinkedIn and cold-emailing hosts — search a curated database of real opportunities by industry, format, and keywords.
Generate pitch emails, save opportunities with notes, track applications, and get alerts so you never miss an opening.
Speaking builds authority and opens client conversations — this keeps your pipeline and follow-through organized.
FIND AI SPEAKING GIGS
ACTUAL TOOL INTERFACE
PRICING CALCULATOR + PROPOSAL GENERATOR
ACTUAL TOOL INTERFACE
TOOL 02
Pricing Calculator + Proposal GeneratorNEW

Use discovery-call information to help determine appropriate package pricing and create a professional proposal.

Pricing is where most new consultants freeze — this turns what you learn on a discovery call into three ready-to-present packages with confident numbers.
It protects you from undercharging and overthinking, with guidance shaped by your experience level and the value you deliver.
The proposal is generated for you — a polished, professional document that makes you look established from your very first client conversation.
TOOL 03
AI Audit ToolNEW

Enter information about a business to help identify where AI may be useful and where opportunities may exist.

The hardest part of consulting is proving your value before anyone has paid you. The audit gives you a professional, structured deliverable from your very first conversation.
Use it as a paid audit engagement on its own — or as the natural opening to a larger consulting project.
You don’t have to build the analysis from scratch. The structure is ready, so you can walk into any meeting looking established from day one.
AI AUDIT TOOL
ACTUAL TOOL INTERFACE
And those are just the headliners.

More supporting tools are positioned throughout the program — each one built to save you time on a specific task, so you spend less time on the busywork and more time becoming the consultant.

Business Name Generator

Name ideas for your consulting brand, checked for domains and social handles — so you can pick a name and claim it the same day.

Press Release Builder Pro

When you speak at an event or deliver training, a press release is how you get known for it. This walks you through writing and issuing one, so every engagement builds your visibility.

LinkedIn Bio Generator

LinkedIn is one of the top places clients find you — your bio has to stop the scroll. Answer a few questions and get a polished About section that positions you as the consultant to hire.

Franny — Feedback Coach

If you need honest feedback on a presentation, a proposal, anything you’re about to put in front of someone — Franny is there to help you make it stronger.

Every tool is included when you enroll.

Lifetime access to the full toolkit, with updates included.

ENROLL NOW

Immediate access upon enrollment.

THE PROGRAM EXPERIENCE
You’ll never be learning alone.
01
Online Training

Learn on your schedule with training and resources built for AI consulting.

02
Live Training

AI changes every month. Your training keeps up. Join live sessions every other week (plus bonus sessions), held in EST and all recorded inside your portal.

03
Workshop-Style Sessions

Interactive, practical sessions designed around application.

04
Private Community

Connect, share ideas, and collaborate with other participants in our private Skool community.

OUR AI CONSULTANT SHOWCASE
Don’t just learn.
Show what you know.

A free, three-day virtual event where program members present to hundreds of professionals. We help you shape your talk and prepare to take the stage.

Open to all program members — presenting opportunities come around every 4 months.

FREE · LIVE ONLINE · HOSTED BY ALICIA LYTTLE

MEET ALICIA LYTTLE
Learn from someone who has been in the room.

Alicia Lyttle is an AI strategist, entrepreneur, educator, and TEDx speaker with more than two decades of experience at the intersection of technology, digital transformation, and business innovation.

Alicia is the CEO of AI InnoVision. She and her sister, Lorette Lyttle, co-founded both AI InnoVision and the International Association of Artificial Intelligence Consultants.

Her work focuses on helping people and organizations understand how AI can be applied in practical, responsible, and meaningful ways.

She has trained professionals, executives, entrepreneurs, educators, and leaders across industries and around the world.

She doesn’t do it alone — you’ll learn from Alicia and team, including Lorette Lyttle, who teaches in the program and supports members every step of the way.

She began her career at the White House and U.S. Environmental Protection Agency before building a global training business and eventually focusing deeply on artificial intelligence.

Her experience sits at the intersection of technology, business, education, and human development.

“AI should empower people.”

THE ORGANIZATION BEHIND THE PROGRAM
Built for the AI era.

AI InnoVision is a global AI education, consulting, workforce development, certification, and innovation organization focused on helping people, organizations, and communities thrive in an AI-powered future.

Its mission: creating opportunity through AI, not simply efficiency.

THE LYTTLE SISTERS
The visionary and the implementer.

Alicia is the CEO and the visionary — and the lead trainer. She likes to be on the front line: on stage, in the live sessions, and working directly with the people the program serves.

Lorette is the COO and the implementer. With a Fortune 500 background as an IT project manager and a Six Sigma Black Belt, she runs the operations that keep everything — training, tools, and community — working seamlessly, and she teaches in the program too.

One sets the vision. The other makes it real. That partnership is how AI InnoVision — and this certification program — is run every day.
